info.title: Coroutine Visualizer API
info.description: REST API for the Kotlin Coroutine Visualizer. SSE streaming events are defined separately in events.ts.

get.summary: Get session snapshot with coroutine state
Get all events for a session
Get coroutine hierarchy tree for a session

parameters.name: scopeId
parameters.description: Optional scope ID to filter hierarchy

get.summary: Get thread activity data for a session
The session's derived health, live or at a replay cursor
get.description: What the captured coroutines show (spec 2026-10-21, C-3): failed rounds, ungrouped failures and possibly blocked coroutines, observations, origin counts, transport and retention facts; every list is capped at 50 with its total. Without atSeq the health is live; with it, it is the fold of the retained events up to the cursor (clamped to the last event), seeded from the durable summaries for coroutines whose creation was trimmed.

parameters.name: atSeq
parameters.description: Replay cursor (event seq). Omit for live health.

parameters.name: leakThresholdMs
parameters.description: Long-lived threshold in ms, as on /metrics (default 30000, clamped to 1000..3600000)

400.description: atSeq is not a non-negative integer

503.description: Health unavailable: code summaries-unavailable, or history-trimmed for a database session whose early events were trimmed

get.summary: Get timeline for a specific coroutine

post.summary: Run validation rules against a session's events

get.description: Produces a structured diff between two visualization sessions. The comparison includes aggregate differences (coroutine count, event count, duration, thread utilization), coroutines unique to each session, and per-coroutine state and event count comparisons for shared coroutines.

404.description: One or both sessions not found

startedAtEpochMs.description: When the session was created (backend wall clock)

captureStartAppNanos.description: App-clock time of the earliest event captured; null when unknown

appConnected.description: Whether an app's ingest socket is open on this backend right now

lastIngestEpochMs.description: Backend receipt time of the last event frame from the app

oldestRetainedSeq.description: Seq of the oldest event still retained

totalDuration.description: Total time from creation to completion in nanoseconds

activeDuration.description: Time spent actively running in nanoseconds

openPhase.description: For an unfinished coroutine, the phase it has been in since its last recorded transition. Null once finished.

openPhaseSinceNanos.description: tsNanos of the transition that opened openPhase (the emitting JVM's monotonic clock).

createdAtNanos.description: Creation time on the emitting JVM's monotonic clock (tsNanos).

createdAtEpochMs.description: Creation time on the emitting JVM's wall clock, in epoch milliseconds.

observedAtEpochMs.description: The backend's wall clock when it built this timeline. With createdAtNanos and createdAtEpochMs a client can estimate the emitting JVM's current tsNanos, assuming both hosts' wall clocks agree.

coroutineDurations.description: Map of coroutine ID to total duration in nanoseconds

suspensionDurations.description: Map of coroutine ID to list of suspension durations in nanoseconds

totalDuration.description: Overall duration of the event stream in nanoseconds

VizEvent.description: Base event shape. Actual events are polymorphic and discriminated by the 'kind' field. See events.ts for full TypeScript types.

SessionComparison.description: Structured diff between two visualization sessions, including aggregate metrics and per-coroutine breakdowns.

coroutineCountDiff.description: Difference in coroutine count (B minus A)

eventCountDiff.description: Difference in event count (B minus A)

totalDurationDiffNanos.description: Difference in total session duration in nanoseconds (B minus A)

distinctThreadsDiff.description: Difference in distinct-thread (thread-utilization) count between the two sessions (B minus A), derived from ThreadAssigned events.

coroutinesOnlyInA.description: Coroutine IDs present only in session A

coroutinesOnlyInB.description: Coroutine IDs present only in session B

commonCoroutines.description: Per-coroutine comparison for coroutines in both sessions

CoroutineComparison.description: Comparison of a single coroutine that exists in both sessions.

label.description: Coroutine label (taken from session A if available)

eventCountA.description: Number of events for this coroutine in session A

eventCountB.description: Number of events for this coroutine in session B

SuspensionPoint.description: Source code location where a coroutine suspended

SessionKind.description: ATTACHED for a connected app's session, DEMO for vizcore's own runs

SessionOrigin.description: REPORTED when the producer reports coroutine origins (or for demos)

appNanos.description: Poll time on the app clock

appEpochMs.description: The app's wall-clock time of that poll

AsOf.description: The observation a health statement is about (spec H-2)

appNanos.description: Latest app-clock time observed in the events up to seq

appEpochMs.description: The app's wall-clock time of the observation, when known

seq.description: Last event seq the health reflects

reason.description: Set if and only if NOT_EVALUATED; the highest-precedence reason

HealthState.description: The health strip's state (spec 'Health strip states')

detailsDropped.description: The summary was reduced: type and message are no longer known

CappedStrings.description: Coroutine ids, newest first, capped at 50

FailedRoundIncident.description: All failed coroutines of one round (spec 'Incidents'); cancellations after the first failure are context

UngroupedFailureIncident.description: A failed coroutine whose round cannot be determined

PossiblyBlockedIncident.description: A coroutine observed running past the threshold up to the latest watermark

lastThread.description: The thread assigned in the current run, null when none was observed

runningForNanos.description: From the latest start/resume to the watermark (app clock)

transitions.description: Up to the 20 most recent retained transitions

transitionsGap.description: The retained transitions do not start with the creation

eventLoopClue.description: The matched event-loop thread prefix (a clue, never a verdict)

CappedIncidents.description: Incidents by kind (failures first), newest first, capped at 50

TransportStatus.description: Sticky for the session across reconnects

lostEvents.description: Largest cumulative loss count an SDK watermark reported

deliveryUncertain.description: An ingest connection ended without a final watermark, a frame could not be read, or the events came through a connection this backend did not watch

sinceSeq.description: First seq that may be incomplete

trimmed.description: Events before the oldest retained one were dropped

asOfSeq.description: The last event seq the health reflects (the cursor in replay)

problemCount.description: Failed rounds + ungrouped failures + possibly blocked

failuresAtLeast.description: Counts may be low (overflow, lost or possibly lost events)

asOfWatermark.description: The watermark the health used (live attached sessions only)
